fusions.name: Gnawing Bite
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A bite that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Creeping Cloud
fusions.desc: A cloud deals 12 damage to everything in a cone 6 tiles long and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target then spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Feeding Frenzy
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Gorged Cells
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once, healing you for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
